headline: Morepen Laboratories VP of Finance resigns
hook: Senior finance leadership exit at Morepen

headline: Morepen Laboratories wins GST refund case in Himachal High Court
hook: Court clears Morepen of tax refund allegations
summary: The Himachal Pradesh High Court has quashed a tax notice issued to Morepen Laboratories regarding an alleged excess GST refund claim of ₹118 crore. The company stated that the court's decision will have no impact on its financial position or ongoing operations. This ruling resolves a significant tax dispute for the pharmaceutical manufacturer.
why_it_matters: Removes potential financial liability and legal uncertainty for the company.
winners_losers: Morepen Laboratories gains / Tax authorities hurt
